fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block plus an articleBody field assembled from the page's HTML body container (scroll.in's JSON-LD never carries articleBody itself), so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, assembled from the page's HTML article-body container (direct-child

tags) since scroll.in's JSON-LD NewsArticle block does not carry articleBody.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date, with IST (+05:30) offset.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified timestamp -- observed to be CMS-generated at render time (microsecond precision) rather than a genuine editorial edit date on most articles.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline as emitted by upstream JSON-LD -- a single Person object with name/sameAs (raw passthrough; observed as always a dict, never a list, across all 4 content types sampled). Often 'Scroll Staff' for unbylined wire/desk items.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher Organization object (name, url, logo, sameAs).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated topic tags, as emitted upstream (article-mode from JSON-LD; latest-mode from the sitemap's news:keywords).

publication_date.title: Publication date
publication_date.description: ISO 8601 publish date with IST offset, from the sitemap's news:publication_date (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
